use_case_summary: ResolveIQ is replacing a brittle rule-based knowledge assist and expensive 3rd-party classifier. Primary goals: give agents concise, sourced answers; auto-summarize tickets; run tool calls (create/escalate/update ticket) from the assistant UI. Needs deterministic citations, fresh content (minutes-to-hours), and multi-source retrieval across Zendesk, Confluence, and an internal product DB.
notes:
Prod constraints and shorthand notes:
- Workload: ~3k incoming tickets/day, 20 steady agents, peaks up to 200 concurrent agents during releases (10x spikes).
- Targets: agent-assist p95 latency < 350ms (response assemble + retrieval), end-to-end UI latency budget 500ms preferred; summarization batch throughput target 500 tickets/hr for async workflows.
- RAG specifics: must surface provenance (source title, link, snippet, last_modified). Citations mandatory in agent UI — compliance/regulatory readout.
- Freshness: policy: knowledge sources require <15min push for incident articles, hourly for product docs. Real-time changefeed integration preferred (webhooks + CDC).
- Retrieval: hybrid dense+BM25; vector DB for semantic retrieval, delta-indexing strategy for hot docs; expect many short documents (kb articles) causing cold-start noise — need smart chunking and reranking.
- Model prefs: open models ok for POC (Llama-2/3.5), want fallbacks to smaller low-cost variants under extreme load; model-variant routing and graceful degradation important.
- Tool-calling: createTicket/escalate/run-scripts via secure signed calls to existing ticketing API (OAuth2 client creds). Must support idempotency for retries.
- Cost sensitivity: wants recommendations for batching, caching (prefix + KV), and quantization tradeoffs — candidate for Redwood Optimize.
- Security: must support SSO (SAML), audit logs for every model call, ability to purge transcripts, KMS-backed key management, and EU data residency for EU customers.
- Quote from Head of Support: "We need answers that point back to our docs — agents cannot guess anymore. If the model hallucinates, we fail audits."
- Integrations: Zendesk as primary ticket store, Confluence for long-form docs, internal product DB (Postgres) for small fragments. Want connectors/examples.
- Acceptance criteria for POC: 1) agent assist UI shows top-3 sources with timestamps, 2) p95 retrieval+model < 500ms in test harness, 3) index update latency < 15min for incident articles, 4) cost analysis under 2x projected baseline.
- Ops ask: roadmap for Dedicated capacity and minimum sustained QPS; SLAs around rollout/rollbacks and canarying.
